howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyerTitle: Here's how your buy order gets matched
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellerTitle: Here's how your sell order gets matched
howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyStep1: There are available sell orders at various prices on the order book. You wish to buy 15 shares at a maximum of RM12.00 per share.
howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyStep2: Your order will be matched with the lowest-priced shares first, in this case: 10 @ RM10.00 and 5 @ RM11.00.
howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyStep3:
Outcome
  • You now own 15 shares totalling RM155.00*
  • Your ave. price per share is RM10.20
  • The order is fully matched & cleared from the order book
  • Your shares are now visible on your portfolio

*excluding trading fees
howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyPreMarketStep1: Before the market opens, there are available buy & sell orders at various prices on the order book. You wish to buy 20 shares at a maximum of RM15.00 per share & are positioned at the top of the order book due to your bid price being the highest.
howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyPreMarketStep2: Once the market opens, your order will be matched with the lowest-priced shares first, in this case: 15 @ RM11.00 and 5 @ RM11.50.
howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyPreMarketStep3:
Outcome
  • You now own 20 shares totalling RM222.50*
  • Your ave. price per share is RM11.13
  • The order is fully matched & cleared from the order book
  • The order is now visible on your portfolio

*excluding trading fees
howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyBlankStep1: You wish to buy 20 shares at a maximum of RM15.00 per share. However, there are presently no available sell orders on the order book. Your order is positioned at the top of the order book due to your bid price being the highest.
howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyBlankStep2: Upon waiting, a new sell order for RM14.00 per share is opened. Your order will be matched at 15 @ RM15.00, which is your buy order price.
howItWorksPage.tutorialBuyBlankStep3:
Outcome
  • You now own 15 shares totalling RM225.00*
  • Your ave. price per share is RM15.00
  • The order is partially matched, with 5 shares still unmatched. This will remain on the order book for future matches**
  • The order is now visible on your portfolio

*excluding trading fees; **until the order book reset
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellStep1: There are available buy orders at various prices on the order book. You wish to sell 20 of your existing shares at a minimum of RM12.00 per share.
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellStep2: Your order will be matched with the highest-priced shares first, in this case: 12 @ RM13.00 and 8 @ RM12.80.
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellStep3:
Outcome
  • You have now sold 20 shares totalling RM258.40*
  • Your ave. price per share is RM12.92
  • The order is fully matched & cleared from the order book
  • The share quantity change is reflected on your portfolio

*excluding trading fees
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellPreMarketStep1: Before the market opens, there are available buy & sell orders at various prices on the order book. You wish to sell all 30 of your existing shares at a minimum of RM11.00 per share & are positioned at the top of the order book due to your ask price being the lowest.
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellPreMarketStep2: Once the market opens, the buy orders will be matched first, which means the executed price depends on the sell orders. Your order will be matched with the highest-positioned buy orders, in this case: 20 + 10 @ RM11.00.
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellPreMarketStep3:
Outcome
  • You have now sold 30 shares totalling RM330.00*
  • Your ave. price per share is RM11.00
  • The order is fully matched & cleared from the order book
  • The shares are cleared from your portfolio

*excluding trading fees
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellBlankStep1: You wish to sell all 20 of your existing shares at a minimum of RM15.00 per share. However, there are presently no buy orders on the order book. You are positioned at the top of the order book due to your ask price being the lowest.
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellBlankStep2: Upon waiting, a new buy order for RM15.00 per share is opened, which meets your ask price. This will be matched with your order, at your ask price of RM15.00 as your order was placed first.
howItWorksPage.tutorialSellBlankStep3:
Outcome
  • You have now sold 10 shares totalling RM150.00*
  • Your ave. price per share is RM15.00
  • The order is partially matched, with 10 shares still unmatched. This will remain on the order book for future matches**
  • The share quantity change is reflected on your portfolio

*excluding trading fees; **until the order book reset

shariahPage.principleJusticeDesc: The rights of all parties in a transaction are upheld, ensuring that no one is wronged or taken advantage of.
shariahPage.principleConsentDesc: Transactions are based on voluntary and informed terms, respecting the autonomy of all parties.
shariahPage.principleHarmDesc: Transactions are conducted ethically, ensuring no harm to any party.
shariahPage.principleTransparencyDesc: Transactions are performed with transparency, fostering trust with investors.
shariahPage.principleRightsDesc: The rights of all parties involved are upheld in every transaction.

shariahPage.benefitEthicalDesc: Shariah-compliant investing aligns with Islamic values and avoids prohibited industries, while promoting social good through sectors like healthcare and renewable energy.
shariahPage.benefitRiskDesc: The profit and loss are equally shared, where both investor and business owner share risks and rewards, unlike traditional fixed-return finance.
shariahPage.benefitDiversificationDesc: Offers a range of products, including Shariah ECF, allowing investors to diversify portfolios while following Islamic principles.
shariahPage.benefitAccountabilityDesc: Investments involve clear contracts to avoid ambiguity and include oversight to maintain ethical standards and reduce fraud.
shariahPage.founderAlignmentDesc: The rise in demand for ethical and socially responsible investing aligns with Shariah-compliant investing, offering a way to contribute positively to society while achieving financial returns.
shariahPage.founderDifferentiationDesc: Adhering to Shariah principles gives businesses a competitive advantage by attracting investors, enhancing reputation, and expanding access to a broader, socially-driven investment base.

shariahPage.noRoomTitle: Leave no room for doubt in your portfolio
shariahPage.assuranceSubtitle: We guarantee that all Shariah-compliant investment opportunities fully meet regulatory standards, offering you peace of mind with every investment
shariahPage.assuranceOversightDesc: Advice and consultation provided through pitchIN's engagements with issuers from start till end of the process.

risk.riskWarningDesc1: Equity Crowdfunding is a viable investment tool. It gives you the opportunity to access early stage investments in Malaysian companies which, prior to the introduction of equity crowdfunding legislations, were only accessible to venture capital companies and sophisticated investors.
risk.riskWarningDesc2: Like all investments, this new marketplace has risks you should be aware of. Please take the time to thoroughly understand the characteristics of equity crowdfunding.
risk.businessRiskDesc: Companies seeking to raise funds will typically be early stage or startup companies. Some may be at idea stage while others may have just become profitable. Investing in companies at such early stages may potentially result in significant gains. But new companies are also likely to fail and you could lose your entire investment. In other cases, companies may not grow as expected and end up not hitting their projected targets.
risk.illiquidityDesc: Equity crowdfunding investments should be done with a long term view. You are investing for the time when the company becomes big and perhaps make an exit when there is an IPO or trade sale. Until then, it may be difficult to find buyers for your shares quickly. And you may have to find buyers yourself. We believe that eventually there will be a secondary market to trade these shares but until then be prepared to hang on to your investment for the long term.
risk.returnsDesc: Startups and early stage companies are focused on growth not returns. They are unlikely to pay out dividends. Profits, if any, are usually reinvested into the business.
risk.dilutionDesc: Growing companies are likely to raise multiple funding rounds. When new shares are issued, your stake is likely to be diluted unless you take your proportion of the new funding requirements. Dilution is not necessarily a bad thing as the value of your stake may be higher than your initial investment if the company’s valuation increases in that funding round. But in some cases, that may not happen and your stake will be diluted in both percentage and value.

risk.noCoverECFDesc: Any loss arising from trading or investment through equity crowdfunding is not covered by the Capital Market Compensation Fund. Investors will not be entitled to receive any compensation from the Fund in respect of such losses.

riskIeo.riskWarningDesc1: Token Crowdfunding (TCF) is an innovative way for companies to raise funds and for the public to diversify their investments. TCF is regulated by the Securities Commission of Malaysia and pitchIN has obtained approval from the Securities Commission to operate this TCF Platform.
riskIeo.riskWarningDesc2: Like all investments, TCF has risks you should be aware of. Please take the time to thoroughly understand the characteristics of TCF before you invest.
riskIeo.businessRiskDesc: Companies seeking to raise funds will typically be early stage or startup companies. Some may be at idea stage while others may have just become profitable. Investing in companies at such early stages may potentially result in significant gains. But new companies are also likely to fail and you could lose your entire investment. In other cases, companies may not grow as expected and end up not hitting their projected targets.
riskIeo.illiquidityDesc: TCF investments should be done with a long-term view. The trading, usage or sale of your TCF Tokens may be restricted to approved avenues in order to comply with securities laws. Unless otherwise specified in the TCF Campaign, you should presume that you will need to hold on to your TCF Tokens for the long-term.
riskIeo.returnsDesc: Startups and early stage companies are focused on growth, not returns. TCF Tokens may not carry rights to financial returns.

pitchin.aboutPitchinDesc: Welcome to pitchIN, the digital platform for investing and fundraising that connects entrepreneurs with potential investors. pitchIN started its journey in crowdfunding, firstly as a reward crowdfunding platform in 2012.
pitchin.aboutPitchinDesc2: In 2015, pitchIN applied and was successful in securing registration as a Recognised Market Operator (RMO) with the Securities Commission of Malaysia to offer an Equity Crowdfunding platform.
pitchin.aboutPitchinStory2012: pitchIN was founded by Sam Shafie and Kasminder Singh in June 2012 as the Reward Crowdfunding platform
pitchin.aboutPitchinStory2015: Recognized as a Recognised Market Operator (RMO) by the Securities Commission Malaysia (SC)
pitchin.aboutPitchinStory2021: Secured RM5.5 million from 325 investors via its Equity Crowdfunding (ECF) platform
pitchin.aboutPitchinStory2022:
• Received SC approval to host Shariah-compliant investment deals, broadening its inclusivity and appeal
  • Approved by the SC to launch Malaysia’s first public Secondary Market (PSTX), enabling investors to trade shares seamlessly
  • Expanded into Token Crowdfunding (TCF) with SC approval to launch the platform for this innovative fundraising avenue
  • Raised RM5 million from MTDC and Gobi Partners, securing capital to fuel further growth
  • Facilitated Malaysia’s largest ECF campaign, raising an unprecedented RM20 million for a single issuer
pitchin.aboutPitchinStory2023:
• Introduced Malaysia’s first Fundraising Accelerator, empowering entrepreneurs with the skills for successful fundraising
  • Successfully hosted the first Shariah-compliant ECF campaign by Apping Technology, which was oversubscribed
pitchin.aboutPitchinStory2024:
• Launched PSTX, Malaysia’s first Secondary Market for ECF, enabling liquidity for investors
  • Hosted Malaysia’s first Token Crowdfunding (TCF) deal and its first public TCF campaign, raising RM10 million
  • Completed 16 cohorts of the Fundraising Accelerator under pitchIN Academy, supporting hundreds of entrepreneurs in their fundraising journeys
pitchin.ourMissionDesc: Make it easy for startups to find the funding they need to grow and succeed. We believe that capital should be accessible to everyone, and we're committed to helping entrepreneurs from all backgrounds.
pitchin.empowerEntrepreneursDesc1: Our platform allows entrepreneurs to create a profile, share their business plan, and connect with potential investors. We also offer resources and tools to help entrepreneurs improve their pitch and increase their chances of success.
pitchin.empowerEntrepreneursDesc2: The pitchIN team is made up of experienced entrepreneurs and investors who understand the challenges of starting a business. We're passionate about helping the next generation of entrepreneurs succeed, and we're dedicated to providing the support and resources they need to make their dreams a reality.
pitchin.ourLeadershipDesc: The pitchIN management team has the right blend of people from the finance, startup and corporate sectors. There is established credibility and extensive networking within the startup community; close relationships with accelerators and incubators; strong ties with relevant government agencies and links with both domestic and international VCs and angels.
pitchin.journeyDesc1: If you're an entrepreneur looking for funding, we invite you to join our community and create a profile on pitchIN. And if you're an investor looking for the next big thing, we invite you to explore the profiles of our entrepreneurs and find the next great opportunity.
pitchin.journeyDesc2: We believe in the democratisation of fundraising and investing. We enable the process for investors to invest in businesses they believe and for businesses to grow with the support of their investors.
pitchin.thankYou: Thank you for choosing pitchIN as your partner in the pursuit of success.
